title: Tissue-anchored regional expression contrasts in colorectal cancer Visium data
description: Analysis code and derived results for a morphology-defined near-versus-far stromal expression comparison in two public colorectal cancer Visium resources. This version includes the revised manuscript's figures, Table 1 and supporting tables with their generating scripts and derived inputs. Reference and alternative maps in the separate simulation are constructed displacements of a known boundary, not clustering outputs. Real-resource map results are repeated selections within patients and do not demonstrate local histological-boundary movement or a supported primary direction reversal. Full raw-expression replay requires additional source-compatible registered inputs described in the manifest.
